page.overview:
Who is Bart and Darcy's baby?

Bart and Darcy's baby is the future child of Darcy and Bart Simpson.

Bart wonders how his life in Utah will be after his marriage with Darcy. He thus imagines itself that after their marriage, they will be parents of a baby who is in Darcy's womb.
